style.name: Cezanne
style.description: Style Atlas daily pick: Cezanne / 塞尚式结构. Build every news scene from stable geometric volumes, tilted spatial planes, constructive broken brushwork, quiet tension and an earthy palette of ochre, olive, slate blue, terracotta and cream. Translate each topic into a distinct evidence-rich editorial scene rather than copying a painting, repeating a template or using generic cards. Content, evidence and information occupy at least 70%; Xiazi and Doudou together stay around 10-15% at edges or the bottom. Reduce information density by about 20%: one conclusion and at most three large facts in three to five clear modules, with calm low-texture text fields and generous spacing. NO.01 preserves all eight numbered one-sentence summaries exactly around a central faceted globe and newsroom still-life, using naturally staggered ribbons, landscape planes and quiet painted fields instead of an eight-box grid, table, equal cards or dense borders. Chinese and English preserve the same scene, hierarchy and rhythm. Every poster must be native 1:2 and exactly 887x1774, with undistorted people, circles and type, visible xiazishuo.com in the bottom safe area, and no full-edge white or near-white strip. Fill the full canvas with painted color and scene detail while keeping every text block highly readable.

zh-CN.headlineView: 医疗科研AI、一人用户研究、AI足球教练、跨境时装、母婴阻断、活细胞显微镜、矮行星候选与气候承诺进入同一张行动地图
zh-CN.headlineFull: 10月31日全球经营雷达；医疗科研AI、一人用户研究、AI足球教练、跨境时装、母婴阻断、活细胞显微镜、矮行星候选与气候承诺进入同一张行动地图
zh-CN.intro:
1. Meta把Muse等模型交给五所美国大学在校内环境研究心衰、阿尔茨海默病、婴儿监测与科学推理，患者数据不交给Meta。
2. 一人开发的ValidateThat向UX团队和创业者销售用户研究工具，Stripe验证累计收入7497美元、MRR 732美元。
3. FootballGPT用AI生成训练计划、动画战术图和视频技术分析，Stripe验证累计收入32708美元、MRR 5127美元。
4. DISSH将跨境税费、支付和履约本地化后，六个月全球线上收入同比增长86%，英国收入增长391%。
5. WHO认证巴巴多斯消除艾滋病母婴传播，2022至2024年没有报告婴儿母婴感染。
6. 东京大学显微镜把活细胞三维化学成像加速约400倍，达到每秒19.2个三维体积。
7. Rubin天文台发现矮行星候选2026 ED138，估计直径约612至1530公里。
8. UNFCCC汇总154个缔约方的新气候承诺，按现有承诺2035年排放只比2019年低约6%。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 今天的共同线索，是让模型、收入、生命与气候承诺都接受可验证数字和真实边界。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 平台数据、厂商案例、官方认证和科研结果证据等级不同，先看口径再行动。

en-US.headlineView: Medical research AI, solo user research, an AI football coach, cross-border fashion, HIV prevention, live-cell microscopy, a dwarf-planet candidate and climate pledges on one action map
en-US.headlineFull: Global Operator Radar — October 31; Medical research AI, solo user research, an AI football coach, cross-border fashion, HIV prevention, live-cell microscopy, a dwarf-planet candidate and climate pledges on one action map
en-US.intro:
1. Meta is giving Muse and other models to five US universities for on-premise work on heart failure, Alzheimer's, infant monitoring and scientific reasoning, without patient data going to Meta.
2. Solo-built ValidateThat sells user-research tools to UX teams and founders, with $7,497 lifetime revenue and $732 MRR verified by Stripe.
3. FootballGPT uses AI for training plans, animated drill diagrams and video technique analysis, with $32,708 lifetime revenue and $5,127 MRR verified by Stripe.
4. After localizing cross-border tax, payments and fulfilment, DISSH grew global online revenue 86% year on year in six months and UK revenue 391%.
5. WHO certified Barbados for eliminating mother-to-child HIV transmission, with no infant cases from vertical transmission reported from 2022 through 2024.
6. A University of Tokyo microscope accelerated 3D chemical imaging of living cells about 400-fold, reaching 19.2 volumes per second.
7. Rubin Observatory found dwarf-planet candidate 2026 ED138, estimated at roughly 612 to 1,530 kilometres wide.
8. UNFCCC synthesized new pledges from 154 Parties, but current commitments cut 2035 emissions only about 6% below 2019.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Today's shared pattern is making models, revenue, life and climate pledges answer to verifiable numbers and real limits.
en-US.doudouQuote: Platform data, vendor cases, official certification and research evidence are different levels—read the definitions before acting.

zh-CN.headlineFact: Meta把AI模型带进五所大学的真实科研
zh-CN.headlineView: Muse、SAM、DINO与SeamlessM4T在校内环境处理敏感数据，研究心衰、阿尔茨海默病、婴儿监测和可验证科学推理
zh-CN.headlineFull: Meta把AI模型带进五所大学的真实科研；Muse、SAM、DINO与SeamlessM4T在校内环境处理敏感数据，研究心衰、阿尔茨海默病、婴儿监测和可验证科学推理
zh-CN.intro: Meta AI Research公布与加州理工、俄亥俄州立、路易斯安那州立、印第安纳大学和得州大学休斯敦健康科学中心的项目。医疗项目由大学在自己的基础设施中运行Meta模型，院校保留患者与临床数据控制权，数据不提供给Meta。项目包括：用Muse把腹部CT、病历和心电图结合以提前识别射血分数保留型心衰；建立医生在环的阿尔茨海默病多智能体决策系统；用SAM在床旁摄像头和边缘设备上监测婴儿气管切开管脱落；用SeamlessM4T在低成本Android上离线提供多语言新生儿照护；以及让模型生成Lean 4可检查的科研产物。部分系统只有原型、回顾性队列或计划中的用户研究，尚非临床产品；准确性、偏差、医生依赖、隐私治理和监管仍需独立验证。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 医疗AI真正前进的一步，不是更会回答，而是能在数据不出院的前提下进入可验证工作流。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 研究合作不是临床批准；先看前瞻试验、错误类型和医生什么时候该不信模型。

en-US.headlineFact: Meta models enter real research at five universities
en-US.headlineView: Muse, SAM, DINO and SeamlessM4T run inside university environments on heart failure, Alzheimer's, infant monitoring and verifiable scientific reasoning
en-US.headlineFull: Meta models enter real research at five universities; Muse, SAM, DINO and SeamlessM4T run inside university environments on heart failure, Alzheimer's, infant monitoring and verifiable scientific reasoning
en-US.intro: Meta AI Research announced projects with Caltech, Ohio State, Louisiana State University, Indiana University and UTHealth Houston. Universities will run Meta models inside their own environments for healthcare work, retain control of patient and clinical data, and not share that data with Meta. Projects include combining abdominal CT, records and ECG data with Muse to identify HFpEF risk earlier; a clinician-in-the-loop multi-agent system for Alzheimer's diagnosis; bedside and edge use of SAM to detect infant tracheostomy displacement; offline multilingual newborn-care guidance on low-cost Android devices using SeamlessM4T; and Lean 4 tooling that makes model-generated scientific artifacts formally checkable. Some efforts are prototypes, retrospective cohorts or planned user studies rather than clinical products. Accuracy, bias, clinician reliance, privacy governance and regulation still need independent validation.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The meaningful step in medical AI is not answering better, but entering verifiable workflows while sensitive data stays inside the institution.
en-US.doudouQuote: A research collaboration is not clinical approval. Look for prospective trials, error types and when clinicians should distrust the model.

sources.title: How American Universities Are Using AI Models From Meta to Accelerate Medical and Scientific Breakthroughs

zh-CN.headlineView: 把创意验证、卡片分类、树测试、原型测试和问卷整合给UX团队与创业者，靠SEO和Google Ads获客
zh-CN.headlineFull: ValidateThat一人开发，验证MRR 732美元；把创意验证、卡片分类、树测试、原型测试和问卷整合给UX团队与创业者，靠SEO和Google Ads获客
zh-CN.intro: ValidateThat由Ryan Byrne一人开发，向UX团队、独立开发者、教育者和学生销售用户研究工具。客户可描述商业创意获得市场判断，再运行卡片分类、树测试、原型测试和问卷，并通过Prolific招募参与者。TrustMRR通过Stripe验证累计收入7497美元、MRR 732美元和24个活跃订阅；免费版用于试用，Starter每月19美元，Pro每月49美元。主要获客渠道为SEO和Google Ads，产品用React、Redis、Vercel和Stripe交付，数字化研究流程降低人工服务成本。创始人表示已完成团队功能，因其他项目出售。限制是订阅样本小、平均经常性收入约每订阅30美元，付费广告回收、参与者招募成本、研究质量和B2B销售周期未披露；出售状态也增加持续运营风险。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人公司可以不替客户做研究，而是把最常见的研究步骤产品化，让客户自己完成。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 732美元MRR证明有人付费，但广告回收、招募成本和留存决定它能否长成稳定生意。

en-US.headlineView: Idea validation, card sorting, tree testing, prototype studies and surveys are packaged for UX teams and founders, acquired through SEO and Google Ads
en-US.headlineFull: Solo-built ValidateThat verifies $732 MRR; Idea validation, card sorting, tree testing, prototype studies and surveys are packaged for UX teams and founders, acquired through SEO and Google Ads
en-US.intro: Ryan Byrne built ValidateThat alone for UX teams, indie hackers, educators and students. Customers can describe a business idea for a market verdict, then run card sorts, tree tests, prototype tests and surveys, with participant recruitment through Prolific. TrustMRR verifies $7,497 lifetime revenue, $732 MRR and 24 active subscriptions through Stripe. The free tier supports trials; Starter is $19 per month and Pro is $49. Acquisition relies on SEO and Google Ads, while React, Redis, Vercel and Stripe deliver a digital research workflow without a service team. The founder says team features are already implemented and the business is for sale because of other commitments. Constraints are a small subscriber base, roughly $30 MRR per active subscription, undisclosed paid-ad payback, participant recruitment cost, research quality and B2B sales cycle; the sale also adds continuity risk.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A solo company need not perform every study; it can productize the recurring steps so customers run research themselves.
en-US.doudouQuote: $732 MRR proves willingness to pay, but ad payback, recruitment cost and retention decide whether it becomes durable.

zh-CN.headlineView: 把足球教练的训练计划、动画战术图、视频骨骼分析、比赛记录和球探数据做成22种AI工具
zh-CN.headlineFull: FootballGPT验证MRR 5127美元；把足球教练的训练计划、动画战术图、视频骨骼分析、比赛记录和球探数据做成22种AI工具
zh-CN.intro: FootballGPT面向足球教练和教练组，把AI落到训练与复盘：根据球队情境生成训练课，绘制动画练习图，用骨骼叠加分析视频技术，从照片扫描训练计划，并提供比赛语音记录、100多个联赛真实数据的Scout Mode和18名专业顾问。TrustMRR通过Stripe验证累计收入32708美元、MRR 5127美元和539个活跃订阅，约1.5万名用户；定价为每周2.99美元、每月10.99美元或每年99美元，另有每月4.99美元的FM版本。创始人称毛利率84%、月增长140%、运营成本每月95美元；获客来自X、SEO、40多个内容页面和教练社群。收入由支付接口验证，但毛利、增长和成本来自创始人描述；内容准确性、联赛数据许可、季节性、订阅流失与教练专业责任仍是限制。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI应用赚到钱的地方，是把教练的重复准备工作变成能直接上场使用的训练资产。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 5127美元MRR已是真交易，但84%毛利和140%增长仍需区分平台验证与创始人口径。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：赚钱的AI应用落地。

en-US.headlineView: Twenty-two AI tools package training plans, animated drill diagrams, skeletal video analysis, match notes and scouting data for football coaches
en-US.headlineFull: FootballGPT verifies $5,127 MRR; Twenty-two AI tools package training plans, animated drill diagrams, skeletal video analysis, match notes and scouting data for football coaches
en-US.intro: FootballGPT applies AI to training and review for football coaches and staff. It generates sessions from team context, draws animated drill diagrams, overlays skeletons for video technique analysis, scans session plans from photos, captures voice match notes, provides Scout Mode with real data from more than 100 leagues and offers 18 specialist advisers. TrustMRR verifies $32,708 lifetime revenue, $5,127 MRR and 539 active subscriptions through Stripe, with about 15,000 users. Pricing is $2.99 weekly, $10.99 monthly or $99 yearly, plus an FM-only plan at $4.99 monthly. The founder reports 84% gross margin, 140% month-on-month growth and $95 monthly operating cost. Acquisition comes from X, SEO, 40-plus content pages and the coaching community. Revenue is payment-provider verified, while margin, growth and costs are founder claims. Content accuracy, league-data licensing, seasonality, churn and professional coaching liability remain constraints.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The monetized value is turning repetitive coaching preparation into training assets that can be used on the pitch.
en-US.doudouQuote: $5,127 MRR is real commerce, but keep provider-verified revenue separate from founder-reported margin and growth.

zh-CN.headlineFact: DISSH全球线上收入六个月增长86%
zh-CN.headlineView: 两个季节化国际站覆盖200多个目的地，本地货币、含税价、当地支付与合规托管推动英国收入增长391%
zh-CN.headlineFull: DISSH全球线上收入六个月增长86%；两个季节化国际站覆盖200多个目的地，本地货币、含税价、当地支付与合规托管推动英国收入增长391%
zh-CN.intro: 澳大利亚女装品牌DISSH依靠社交媒体获得英国、新加坡等市场需求，但原网站只支持澳元和美元，缺少当地支付，税费与合规摩擦限制结账。品牌与Global-e上线面向南北半球季节差异的两个国际站，覆盖200多个目的地；提供100多种货币、150多种支付方式、按市场定价、含税含关税或结账预付、快递和预付退货，并由Merchant of Record处理跨境税务与合规。厂商案例称，六个月全球线上收入同比增长86%，英国增长391%、新加坡136%、荷兰186%、阿联酋887%；荷兰超过60%顾客使用iDeal或Klarna。数据来自2025年上半年与2024年同期公司口径，未披露利润、退货率、获客成本或Global-e费用；时装尺码退货、当地竞争和汇率仍决定真实利润。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境时装不是把同一网页翻译出去，而是把季节、价格、税费、支付与退货都变成当地体验。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 86%收入增长很强，但这是厂商案例且不是利润；服务费、退货与广告成本要单独算。

en-US.headlineFact: DISSH grows global online revenue 86% in six months
en-US.headlineView: Two seasonally localized sites cover 200-plus destinations, while local currency, landed cost, payment methods and compliance lift UK revenue 391%
en-US.headlineFull: DISSH grows global online revenue 86% in six months; Two seasonally localized sites cover 200-plus destinations, while local currency, landed cost, payment methods and compliance lift UK revenue 391%
en-US.intro: Australian womenswear brand DISSH built demand in markets such as the UK and Singapore through social media, but its old site supported only AUD and USD, lacked local payments and created friction around duties and compliance. With Global-e it launched two international sites tuned to Northern and Southern Hemisphere seasons across more than 200 destinations. The offer includes 100-plus currencies, 150-plus payment methods, market-specific pricing, duties-and-tax-inclusive or prepaid checkout, express shipping and prepaid returns, with Global-e acting as Merchant of Record for tax and compliance. The vendor case says global online revenue rose 86% year on year in six months, with the UK up 391%, Singapore 136%, the Netherlands 186% and the UAE 887%; more than 60% of Dutch shoppers use iDeal or Klarna. Figures compare company data from the first half of 2025 with 2024 and do not disclose profit, returns, acquisition cost or Global-e fees. Fashion sizing returns, local competition and currency still shape real margin.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Cross-border fashion is not translating one storefront; it localizes season, price, duties, payment and returns together.
en-US.doudouQuote: An 86% revenue lift is strong, but this is vendor case data, not profit. Service fees, returns and ads need separate math.

sources.title: Leading Australian fashion house boosts global e-commerce revenues by 86% YoY

zh-CN.headlineFact: 巴巴多斯消除艾滋病母婴传播
zh-CN.headlineView: WHO独立评估确认达标：2022至2024年未报告婴儿母婴感染，产检、检测和孕妇抗病毒治疗覆盖率均达98%
zh-CN.headlineFull: 巴巴多斯消除艾滋病母婴传播；WHO独立评估确认达标：2022至2024年未报告婴儿母婴感染，产检、检测和孕妇抗病毒治疗覆盖率均达98%
zh-CN.intro: WHO于10月30日认证巴巴多斯已把艾滋病母婴传播消除为公共卫生问题。独立评估显示，2022至2024年没有报告由母婴传播造成的婴儿新发HIV感染；98%的孕妇接受产前保健，98%接受HIV检测，98%的HIV阳性孕妇在三年内获得抗病毒治疗。公共诊所和医院提供全民医疗，检测与治疗对所有孕妇免费且不分国籍，暴露婴儿接受早期检测和随访。巴巴多斯加入全球26个在HIV、梅毒或乙肝母婴传播方面获认证或接近达标的国家和地区，其中15个位于美洲。认证不等于病毒消失；维持成果仍需持续投入、更新指南、强化信息系统、扩大HIV与梅毒联合检测，并减少母婴随访脱落。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 消除母婴传播不是一次技术突破，而是把免费检测、治疗和随访连续做到每一位孕妇。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: “消除为公共卫生问题”不等于零HIV；认证靠指标，维持靠长期服务覆盖。

en-US.headlineView: An independent WHO assessment found no infant cases from vertical transmission in 2022–2024, with 98% coverage for antenatal care, HIV testing and treatment
en-US.headlineFull: Barbados eliminates mother-to-child HIV transmission; An independent WHO assessment found no infant cases from vertical transmission in 2022–2024, with 98% coverage for antenatal care, HIV testing and treatment
en-US.intro: On October 30, WHO certified Barbados as having eliminated mother-to-child transmission of HIV as a public health problem. An independent assessment found no new infant HIV infections from vertical transmission reported from 2022 through 2024. Across the three years, 98% of pregnant women received antenatal care, 98% were tested for HIV and 98% of pregnant women living with HIV received antiretroviral treatment. Public clinics and hospitals provide universal care; testing and treatment are free for every pregnant woman regardless of nationality, and exposed babies receive early testing and follow-up. Barbados joins 26 countries and territories worldwide recognized for eliminating or approaching elimination of vertical transmission of HIV, syphilis or hepatitis B, including 15 in the Americas. Certification does not mean HIV has disappeared. Maintaining it requires investment, updated guidance, stronger information systems, wider dual HIV-syphilis testing and better follow-up.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Elimination is not one breakthrough; it is free testing, treatment and follow-up reaching every pregnant woman consistently.
en-US.doudouQuote: 'Eliminated as a public health problem' is not zero HIV. Certification uses thresholds; maintenance depends on durable services.

sources.title: Barbados eliminates mother-to-child transmission of HIV

zh-CN.headlineFact: 显微镜每秒拍下19.2个活细胞三维化学体积
zh-CN.headlineView: 中红外光热层析把传统三维测量加速约400倍，无需荧光标签即可追踪细胞内脂滴与分子光谱
zh-CN.headlineFull: 显微镜每秒拍下19.2个活细胞三维化学体积；中红外光热层析把传统三维测量加速约400倍，无需荧光标签即可追踪细胞内脂滴与分子光谱
zh-CN.intro: 东京大学与RIKEN团队开发视频速率中红外光热光学衍射层析显微镜，用分子振动吸收中红外光后造成的折射率变化，生成活细胞内部化学成分的无标签三维影像。系统把传统三维测量加速约400倍，达到每秒19.2个三维体积，可依据脂质特异信号追踪细胞内脂滴并定量分析运动；它还可在一秒内约20个不同波数上取得三维光谱影像。相较荧光标记，无标签方法避免引入染料并可重复观察真实化学变化，为研究代谢、药物反应与细胞器动态提供新窗口。当前仍是实验室成像平台，视野、深度、热效应、复杂组织散射、设备成本和数据处理量会限制临床或高通量应用；结果也需要在更多细胞和组织中验证。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 显微镜不只看见细胞结构，还开始以视频速度看见化学成分怎样在三维空间中移动。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 19.2体积每秒是实验系统能力；进入组织和临床前，还要解决深度、散射和成本。

en-US.headlineFact: A microscope captures 19.2 live-cell chemical volumes each second
en-US.headlineView: Mid-infrared photothermal tomography accelerates conventional 3D measurement about 400-fold, tracking lipid droplets and spectra without fluorescent labels
en-US.headlineFull: A microscope captures 19.2 live-cell chemical volumes each second; Mid-infrared photothermal tomography accelerates conventional 3D measurement about 400-fold, tracking lipid droplets and spectra without fluorescent labels
en-US.intro: A University of Tokyo and RIKEN team built video-rate mid-infrared photothermal optical diffraction tomography. It detects refractive-index changes caused when molecular vibrations absorb mid-infrared light, producing label-free 3D images of chemical components inside living cells. The system accelerates conventional 3D measurement about 400-fold to 19.2 volumes per second. It tracks intracellular lipid droplets through lipid-specific signals and quantifies their motion, while also acquiring 3D spectroscopic images at roughly 20 different wavenumbers within one second. Unlike fluorescence labeling, the method does not add dyes and can repeatedly observe native chemical change, opening a window on metabolism, drug response and organelle dynamics. It remains a laboratory platform: field of view, depth, heating, scattering in complex tissue, instrument cost and data volume could limit clinical or high-throughput use, and performance needs validation across more cells and tissues.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Microscopy is moving from seeing cell structure to watching chemical composition move through 3D space at video speed.
en-US.doudouQuote: 19.2 volumes per second is a laboratory capability. Tissue and clinical use still face depth, scattering and cost.

sources.title: New Microscope Captures 3D Videos of Components Inside Living Cells

zh-CN.headlineFact: Rubin发现首个矮行星候选2026 ED138
zh-CN.headlineView: 这个海王星外天体估计直径612至1530公里，位于冥王星轨道之外，也是已知内在最亮的十个TNO之一
zh-CN.headlineFull: Rubin发现首个矮行星候选2026 ED138；这个海王星外天体估计直径612至1530公里，位于冥王星轨道之外，也是已知内在最亮的十个TNO之一
zh-CN.intro: NSF—DOE Vera C. Rubin天文台在早期观测数据中发现2026 ED138，这是该台首个太阳系矮行星候选。团队用代码在数十亿个移动天体探测点中连线同一目标，并在十年以上的DECam历史影像中独立确认。其绝对星等约3.19；按不同反照率估计直径约612至1530公里，足以因自身重力接近球形，但仍需进一步测定，因此只能称候选。轨道半长轴约43.09天文单位、倾角约24.4度，位于海王星12:7平均运动共振边缘；颜色比妊神星碰撞家族更红。它在地面仍足够明亮，可用光谱、光变曲线、Hubble和Webb继续研究。模型推测远离银河平面的区域可能还藏着约3个类似明亮天体，银河平面附近或更多；尺寸、形状、成分和正式分类均未确认。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 新天体不是突然出现，而是更强的巡天和连线算法终于把分散的微弱移动证据拼在一起。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: “矮行星候选”不是已确认矮行星；直径范围取决于反照率，仍要靠后续观测收窄。

en-US.headlineFact: Rubin finds its first dwarf-planet candidate, 2026 ED138
en-US.headlineView: The object beyond Neptune is estimated at 612–1,530 kilometres wide and ranks among the ten intrinsically brightest known trans-Neptunian objects
en-US.headlineFull: Rubin finds its first dwarf-planet candidate, 2026 ED138; The object beyond Neptune is estimated at 612–1,530 kilometres wide and ranks among the ten intrinsically brightest known trans-Neptunian objects
en-US.intro: NSF–DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory found 2026 ED138 in early survey data, its first dwarf-planet candidate in our Solar System. A linking code searched billions of moving-object detections, and the team independently confirmed the target in more than a decade of archival DECam images. Its absolute magnitude is about 3.19; depending on reflectivity, its estimated diameter is roughly 612 to 1,530 kilometres, possibly large enough for gravity to make it round, but more measurement is required, so it remains a candidate. Its semimajor axis is about 43.09 astronomical units with an inclination near 24.4 degrees, at the edge of Neptune's 12:7 mean-motion resonance, and it is redder than the Haumea collision family. It remains bright enough for ground spectroscopy, light curves, Hubble and Webb follow-up. Modelling suggests around three similar bright objects may remain away from the Galactic plane and perhaps more within it. Size, shape, composition and classification are not final.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The object did not suddenly appear; a stronger survey and linking algorithm finally assembled scattered, faint motion evidence.
en-US.doudouQuote: A dwarf-planet candidate is not a confirmed dwarf planet. The size range depends on reflectivity and needs follow-up.

sources.title: NSF–DOE Vera C. Rubin Observatory Reveals Its First Dwarf Planet Candidate in Our Solar System

zh-CN.headlineView: UNFCCC汇总127份新NDC：现有承诺使2035年排放比2019年低约6%，全部有条件措施落实也仅约9%
zh-CN.headlineFull: 154个缔约方承诺仍远离1.5°C路径；UNFCCC汇总127份新NDC：现有承诺使2035年排放比2019年低约6%，全部有条件措施落实也仅约9%
zh-CN.intro: UNFCCC在COP31前发布2026年国家自主贡献综合报告，汇总2024年1月至2026年8月登记的127份新NDC，代表154个《巴黎协定》缔约方，覆盖约70%至71%的2019年全球温室气体排放。报告称，98%的缔约方让地方政府、企业或社会组织参与实施，90%表示新承诺吸收了首次全球盘点结果，气候政策更深入经济治理。但减排仍明显不足：按现有承诺，2035年全球排放平均只比2019年低约6%；即使所有有条件措施完整落实，也约低9%。长期目标对应的最佳估计升温仍约1.7至2.3°C，重返1.5°C需要额外大幅减排。报告汇总的是各国承诺与模型投影，不等于已完成的减排；融资、技术、能力建设和国内执行决定承诺能否落地。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 承诺的覆盖面越来越完整，但气候算术仍不让步：治理进步必须转化为更快的实际减排。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 6%是2035年相对2019年的承诺投影，不是已经实现，也离1.5°C所需路径很远。

en-US.headlineFact: Pledges from 154 Parties remain far off a 1.5°C path
en-US.headlineView: UNFCCC synthesizes 127 new NDCs: current pledges cut 2035 emissions about 6% below 2019, or around 9% with every conditional measure
en-US.headlineFull: Pledges from 154 Parties remain far off a 1.5°C path; UNFCCC synthesizes 127 new NDCs: current pledges cut 2035 emissions about 6% below 2019, or around 9% with every conditional measure
en-US.intro: Ahead of COP31, UNFCCC published its 2026 Nationally Determined Contributions synthesis. It covers 127 new NDCs recorded from January 2024 through August 2026, representing 154 Parties to the Paris Agreement and about 70–71% of global 2019 greenhouse-gas emissions. The report says 98% of Parties involve local authorities, business or civil society in implementation, and 90% say the first global stocktake informed their new commitments, showing climate policy moving deeper into economic governance. Yet reductions remain clearly insufficient. Current pledges put 2035 global emissions only about 6% below 2019; full delivery of every conditional element would reach roughly 9%. Long-term targets imply best-estimate warming of about 1.7–2.3°C, so returning to 1.5°C requires substantial additional cuts. The report synthesizes promises and modelled projections, not completed reductions. Finance, technology, capacity and domestic implementation determine delivery.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Pledges are broader and better structured, but climate arithmetic does not bend: governance progress must become faster real-world cuts.
en-US.doudouQuote: The 6% is a 2035 projection against 2019, not an achieved cut, and it remains far from a 1.5°C pathway.

sources.title: UN Climate Reports Show New NDCs Would Cut Emissions Only 6 Per Cent Below 2019 Levels by 2035
Climate Pledges Now Add Up to a 6% Emissions Cut by 2035
